targetAudience: Creative directors, film editors, motion designers, and creative engineers

emotionalArc.fromState: Assuming great editing is about timeline tools and software plugins
emotionalArc.tensionState: Feeling visceral cognitive friction when focal gaze hunts or equal brightness shatters attention
emotionalArc.toState: Conviction that deterministic code + perceptual craft achieves cinema by design
emotionalArc.coreThesis: Great editing isn't software—it's 60 milliseconds of human perception engineered by design.

kuleshovStrategy: 5-8 literal mixed-media layers per shot: recursive zoom-outs from studio silhouettes into NLE monitors, clean X-ray cortex wired to a macro iris, pupil-locked split-screen match cuts, and tactile StudioCursor UI clicks.
antiGoals: Zero purple, violet, magenta, or raw neon pigments
Zero naked CSS/3D geometric shapes, SaaS 4-column card grids, or fake HUD strings
Zero parked/static text or objects — heavy continuous camera motivation at 25fps
